newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: NBM finalises buy of Dutch networks firm.
newsitem.headline: NBM finalises buy of Dutch networks firm.

text.p: Dutch construction group NBM-Amstelland NV said on Monday it had finalised the acquisition of Dutch network firm Van den Berg Zwammerdam Houdstermaatschappij BV from unlisted ULC Groep BV.
Van den Berg is active in building networks for cable television, traffic systems, data transmission and systems for the distribution of gas, water and electricity.
The firm posts an annual turnover of some 90 million guilders and employs 400 employees, NBM Amstelland said.
Van den Berg will be part of NBM's Traffic and Telecommunications division, which will employ some 600 people and generate a turnover of around 150 million guilders, NBM said.
NBM Amstelland said the takeover of Van den Berg would make a positive contribution to its results, but declined to give financial details on the deal.
NBM said in April it was in talks over the acquisition.
